# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Highlight all instrumentation problems over 100% of the observed data.
3. Separate monitoring sites into those that operate and those that do not operate continuously over time.
4. When developing a meteorological episode of high pollution, describe the synoptic changes as either "barotropic" or "baroclinic".
5. When interpolating large gaps in the data for presentation purposes, use hourly data from an Industrial Control Center (i.e., Quality Assurance Manual), instead of using weather data from a central WGT of the National Weather Service.
6. Keep in mind that "National Weather Service automation has improved the amount of hourly weather data."

Note: Only one of the above steps is incorrect.
